title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to run a Report in Preview Mode without the Request Page (Hide Request Page)
summary: This post explains how to preview a Business Central report without showing the request page. It describes bypassing the request page using UseRequestPage or Report.Run methods, then demonstrates a preferred approach for BC26 that saves reports as PDF and displays them directly in the web client.
key_points: UseRequestPage(false) and Report.Run with RequestWindow=false bypass the request page but disable preview/print options and download the file instead
Business Central 2025 Wave 1 (BC26) enables direct PDF preview in the web client, providing a better user experience
Two practical approaches are provided: using Report Selections for standard reports and direct SaveAs method for fixed reports
Reports can be saved as PDF using SaveReportAsPDFInTempBlob or SaveAs methods, then displayed with File.ViewFromStream

quotes.text: However, doing so disables the preview and print options, causing the file to be downloaded directly.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the limitation of traditional methods for bypassing the request page, motivating the need for an alternative approach

quotes.text: With this feature, you can open PDF attachments directly in the Business Central web client without downloading them first.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the BC26 capability that enables the improved solution for previewing reports without request pages
